title: Exclusive Priority Niagara Boat Tour & Journey Behind Falls
includes: First Access Onboard to secure preferred viewing locations (If Upgrade option selected)
Journey Behind the Falls Admission Ticket
Guided Walking Tour of American Falls, Bridal Veil Falls, and Horseshoe Falls views
Priority Boarding Access (Skip the regular lines)(If Upgrade option selected)
Niagara City Cruise Ticket with Voyage Priority Plus Upgrade
Exclusive Premium Gold Recyclable Poncho (If Upgrade option selected)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Unfortunately due to the nature of this tour it is not suitable for guests with mobility impairments or with wheelchairs.
This is a walking tour, guests should be able to walk at a moderate pace, you'll cover roughly 2 Km (1 mi). We encourage appropriate footwear for uneven surfaces.

Please note that this tour takes place entirely outdoors, regardless of weather conditions. We recommend dressing appropriately for the season. Winter months in particular can be quite cold, be prepared to remain outside for the majority of the tour’s duration.
Please note: this tour is located in Canada, any guest arriving from the US will need a passport to enter Canada.
Please note: This tour offers multiple options. Take a moment to choose the one that best suits your interests.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Official Launch Partner of Niagara City Cruises' New Voyage Priority Plus Upgrade!

Skip the notoriously long lines and experience Niagara Falls like an elite insider. On this exclusive 3-hour guided tour, you will bypass the standard crowds with the region's only tour featuring the brand-new Voyage Priority Plus. Enjoy priority boarding onto the iconic Niagara City Cruise, first choice of the best viewing decks, and an exclusive premium gold poncho. Combined with reserved entry to the breathtaking Journey Behind the Falls, this premium excursion allows you to focus entirely on the raw power of the wonders. 

100% Exclusive Access: Be among the first travellers in the world to experience the brand-new Voyage Priority+ pass.

Skip the Standard Queues with dedicated priority entry lanes.

Elite Deck Placement allows prime, unobstructed viewing locations before the general public boards.

The Gold Standard: Stay dry with recyclable gold ponchos for priority guests with an expert guide.
